shortDescription: Exceptionally clean lines meet extraordinary cleaning performance and it’s also the largest front load washer in its class. The minimalist design is enhanced by an intuitive 7" LCD touchscreen offering elegantly simple operation.

features.text: Minimalist Style, Impressive Capacity
The massive 5.8 cu. ft. tub accommodates king-size bedding, comforters, oversized towels or washable rugs with ease, all while helping to save time by reducing the number of loads each week.
At 29" wide, it’s only slightly larger than standard 27" models but still fits comfortably in most laundry spaces.
Elegantly Simple, with an Intuitive 7" LCD Touchscreen
Go beyond ordinary buttons and dials with an intuitive 7" LCD touchscreen that simplifies laundry and places total control at your fingertips
Built-in Intelligence Takes out the Guesswork

Forget about endless sorting or toggling through cycles built-in sensors use AI technology to detect fabric texture and load size, then automatically select the right wash motions, temperatures and more for advanced fabric care.
With Smart Pairing, the washer can even tell the dryer to select a compatible drying cycle, making it the ultimate laundry hack
Clean Up to 36 Loads with 1 Easy Fill
No more digging out detergent and fabric softener every time you do laundry.
Just fill the reservoirs once and you’re set for up to 20 to 36 wash cycles with the versatility of using detergent and softener or detergent only.
Power Clean Big Loads in Under 30 Minutes
With TurboWash® 360°, you can clean larger loads fast and get more done while enjoying the same great washing performance you expect from LG.
Five powerful jets with variable sprays surround clothes from multiple angles so detergent can penetrate deep into fabrics for a complete clean even for big loads in under 30 minutes.
Reduce Allergens such as Dust, Pollen and Pet Dander in Fabrics
The Allergiene® cycle uses the gentle power of steam to help reduce common household allergens such as dust, pet dander and pollen in fabrics without harsh chemicals.
Perfect for bedding, baby clothes and more.
ThinQ® Helps Make Life Happen
Use the ThinQ® app to control your washer remotely or use voice commands with Alexa and Google voice assistants.
ThinQ UP™ enabled smart appliances may receive software updates for new, downloadable features and enhancements to be sent wirelessly to the appliance.
ThinQ Care™ helps keep your appliance running smoothly by sending proactive usage, maintenance and diagnostic alerts to your smartphone.
Elevate Your Laundry Experience
Wash small loads that can’t wait or two loads at once with the LG SideKick® 29" pedestal washer.
Or, add a 29" pedestal storage drawer to enjoy more comfortable loading and unloading plus extra storage and a basket to keep it all organized.
